items.text: Round 3 decisions incorporated into conclusion: (d1=A) Added 3 new actions for P3/P4 gaps — approval-to-deploy automation (P3, S), LPBS_SERVICE_SECRET validation endpoint (P3, S), and entitlement vs approval documentation clarification (P4, XS). Conclusion now contains 7 total actions covering all identified gaps. (d2=A) Added directive that all backlog items should be created via swarm-manager CLI when this research item is processed.

Readiness assessment unchanged from round 3. All dimensions at 3 except testable (2) — testable remains at 2 because validation was code-only (per round 1 d4=A) with no runtime trace. This is an acknowledged limitation, not a gap that further workshop rounds can close.

The conclusion is self-contained: all 5 audit questions are answered with evidence, system contracts define interface boundaries for all 5 systems, the exhaustive action inventory catalogs API/CLI/UI/skill surfaces, and 7 prioritized actions translate every identified gap into a concrete backlog item. This research item is ready for processing.
